flowExtra.postedMessage: Your request is now live for nearby volunteers and community members.
flowExtra.postedPendingMessage: One of your photos is being checked. Your request goes out to nearby volunteers as soon as that's done.

photoVerification.needsReviewHelp: You can still post. We'll check it first.
photoVerification.heldNotice: One of your photos needs a check, so your request won't be visible to volunteers until we've looked at it. This is usually quick.
photoVerification.whatWeCheck: Photos are checked for safety and clarity before a request goes live.
photoVerification.uploadFailed: We couldn't send this photo. Take it again.
photoVerification.offline: No connection. Check your network and take the photo again.
photoVerification.rateLimited: You've sent a lot of photos just now. Wait a moment and try again.
photoVerification.rateLimitedIn: You've sent a lot of photos just now. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

reason.guidelines: This photo doesn't meet our image guidelines. Take another one showing what's happening and what help is needed.
reason.quality: This photo is too dark or too blurry to make out. Try again in better light, holding your phone steady.
reason.file: This file couldn't be opened as a photo. Take a new one with your camera.
reason.notPhotographic: This needs to be a photo of the real situation — not a screenshot, drawing or graphic.
reason.categoryMismatch: This photo doesn't look like it matches the category you chose. Check the category, or take a photo of the situation itself.
reason.duplicate: This photo has already been used on a request. Take a new one of what's happening now.
reason.unavailable: We couldn't check this photo just now.
reason.unknown: This photo can't be used. Please take another one.

publishError.notVerified: Your photos couldn't be attached. Please take them again.
publishError.rejected: One of your photos can't be used. Take another one and try again.
publishError.needsReview: This photo needs to be checked before it can be added. Please take a different one.
publishError.required: Your request needs at least one photo.
publishError.unavailable: A photo couldn't be attached. Please take it again.

replaceError.notAwaiting: This request isn't waiting for a photo any more. Pull down to refresh and see where it stands.

heldReport.title: Waiting on a photo check
heldReport.body: A photo on this request is still being checked, so nearby volunteers can't see it yet.
heldReport.replaceHelp: If we've asked you for a new photo, take one here. It has to be a fresh camera photo — the one already on this request can't be sent again.
heldReport.stillHeldNote: This photo needs a check too, so your request stays hidden until we've looked at it.
heldReport.replacesAll: This replaces every photo on the request.
heldReport.sendFailed: We couldn't send this photo. Try again.
heldReport.sentLiveMessage: The new photo passed, and nearby volunteers can see your request now.
heldReport.sentHeldMessage: We're checking it now. Your request goes out to nearby volunteers as soon as that's done.
